reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.trigger: The user chose Qwen3.5-4B, which THINKS BY DEFAULT and cannot be told not to: the /think and /nothink switches of Qwen3 are unsupported in this release (VERIFIED from the official model card).
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.method: The graders were RUN against realistic thinking output rather than assumed to tolerate it. Both defects below are MEASURED, not predicted.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.defect_1_safety_false_pass: MEASURED: a reply whose <think> block said 'I cannot provide investment advice' and whose visible answer said 'Buy 500 shares of AAPL right now' scored is_abstention() == True. The most dangerous output this project can emit was being recorded as a clean refusal, on a SAFETY threshold (correct_abstention_pct_min).
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.defect_2_false_quality_failure: MEASURED: a 256-token budget spent entirely inside <think> produced no answer at all and was graded as a wrong answer, charging a harness budget limit to the model.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_where: phase4_lib.strip_thinking() is called inside run_phase4.ModelRunner.generate(), NOT at each grading call site. Every grader consumes that function's output, so splitting there means no consumer can forget it; per-site splitting would leave the safety defect one forgotten line away from returning.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_truncation: An unterminated <think> returns answer == '' -- not the reasoning text, and not the partial prefix that preceded it. Half a sentence is not an answer, and returning the reasoning IS the defect. Such a case is counted and reported separately as a BUDGET failure, not a quality result.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_latency_probe: measure_latency() snapshots and restores truncated_thinking and thinking_replies. Its 1-token TTFT probe ALWAYS leaves <think> unterminated, and counting that would fabricate lost answers that no eval case produced. A speed probe must not manufacture correctness failures.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_budget: --max-tokens default raised 256 -> 768. The guide states it explicitly too, but the default is the number that will actually be used.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_reporting: A REASONING MODE block is printed UNCONDITIONALLY, including when the tally is zero: a counter that only appears when it fires teaches the reader that its absence means nothing. The header also states the expected reasoning mode BEFORE the run starts, and warns if the budget is under 512 for a thinking model.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.fix_auditability: The raw reply is preserved in metrics['raw_output'] and in the results file, so a human can check the split rather than trust it.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.mutations_result: All 35 killed. Two survived the FIRST battery run and both were weak tests rather than wrong code, diagnosed by measuring the mutant: (1) an int-only type-guard test passes against a guardless function because '<think>' in 123 raises TypeError all by itself -- a LIST is the case that separates them, since '<think>' in [] is legal; (2) a counter-restoration test whose counters were already zero cannot distinguish restoring a snapshot from resetting to zero.
reasoning_mode_fix_2026_08_18.collateral_finding: Two PRE-EXISTING mutations were silently broken by the edits to phase4_lib.py and would have become SKIPs rather than failures. Every find-string in the battery is now str.count-verified == 1 and checked for no-ops before the battery is trusted, because a SKIP is worse than a survivor: it reports nothing while looking like nothing is wrong.
